posts.name: SplinterMD
posts.cooked:
Hi, <o:p></o:p>

I’ve just recently discovered SotM and instantly fell in love with, got my copy a week ago and been constantly playing it since. <o:p></o:p>

One of the best games I’ve played in ages and it seems everyone who I’ve introduced the game to agree, from members of the gaming group to the family, everyone been just having a blast. I’ve even got a couple of phone calls from my nephews (6 yo’s) asking when they come to play the “Really cool hero game” again 

<o:p></o:p>

 

I've placed an order for the major expansions when I noticed a couple of online retailers carry the Mini Expansions for a discount price(CSI, Miniature Market, White Dragon on BGG and a couple more) but none of them could give me an answer regarding the inclusion of dividers with the decks.

Was hoping anyone here got some experience with those and could answer that for me

posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked: The official word is that they should have the dividers but several people have been on the forums saying they didn't get them. So there may be issues with communication or distribution for >G to investigate.
